shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- package.json ---' && cat package.json && printf '%s\\n' '--- app/layout.tsx ---' && sed -n '1,240p' app/layout.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- app/page.tsx ---' && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- app/ProductGrid.tsx ---' && sed -n '1,280p' app/ProductGrid.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- app/ProductSkeleton.tsx ---' && sed -n '1,220p' app/ProductSkeleton.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- detail ---' && sed -n '1,300p' app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- css ---' && sed -n '1,360p' app/globals.css && printf '%s\\n' '--- products ---' && sed -n '1,260p' lib/products.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"ViewTransition\" node_modules/@types/react node_modules/react/index.js node_modules/react/cjs/react.development.js node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | sed -n '1,220p' && printf '\\n--- next config ---\\n' && cat next.config.ts && printf '\\n--- Link types ---\\n' && sed -n '40,130p' node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '155,200p' node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts && sed -n '30,118p' node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts && cat tsconfig.json && node -p \"require('./node_modules/react/package.json').version\" && node -e \"import('react').then(r=>console.log('ViewTransition',typeof r.ViewTransition,Object.keys(r).filter(k=>k.toLowerCase().includes('transition'))))\""

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff -- app/page.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx app/globals.css next.config.ts tsconfig.json react-canary.d.ts && printf '\\n--- generated next env ---\\n' && cat next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .gitignore && git diff -- package.json && git ls-files package-lock.json next-env.d.ts tsconfig.json && git show HEAD:tsconfig.json'

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: tsconfig.json
@@
-    \"lib\": [
-      \"dom\",
-      \"dom.iterable\",
-      \"esnext\"
-    ],
+    \"lib\": [\"dom\", \"dom.iterable\", \"esnext\"],
@@
-    \"paths\": {
-      \"@/*\": [
-        \"./*\"
-      ]
-    }
+    \"paths\": {
+      \"@/*\": [\"./*\"]
+    }
   },
-  \"include\": [
-    \"next-env.d.ts\",
-    \"**/*.ts\",
-    \"**/*.tsx\",
-    \".next/types/**/*.ts\",
-    \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\"
-  ],
-  \"exclude\": [
-    \"node_modules\"
-  ]
+  \"include\": [\"next-env.d.ts\", \"**/*.ts\", \"**/*.tsx\", \".next/types/**/*.ts\"],
+  \"exclude\": [\"node_modules\"]
 }
*** End Patch
PATCH
rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts

git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && nl -ba app/ProductGrid.tsx | sed -n '1,90p' && nl -ba app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx | sed -n '30,105p' && nl -ba app/page.tsx | sed -n '1,70p' && nl -ba app/globals.css | sed -n '1,260p' && nl -ba next.config.ts && nl -ba react-canary.d.ts"
